name: Baal Zephon
overview: Baal Zephon is identified in Scripture as an Egyptian city located on the Red Sea, serving as a geographical marker during the Israelites' Exodus journey. The Israelites encamped near Baal Zephon, between Pihahiroth and Migdol, as directed by God (Exodus 14:2; Numbers 33:7). This location also marks the place where Pharaoh's army pursued the Israelites, highlighting its significance in the narrative of God's deliverance (Exodus 14:9).
